name: PRUNING_PLANNED_YELLOW_LONG
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). W8-SA64 750 x 500 (1:10), R50, 10 / 30. PRUNING 100 D baseline 210, 550 (100/550/100); PLANNED 100 D baseline 390 (180 pitch, 110 below), 582 (84/582/84). Only with W5-SA74 (LOW BRANCHES).
